DISH WASHING MACHINE, HEAVY DUTY, RATCHET TYPE -- SPECIFICATION
1 SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies the requirements for heavy duty, ratchet type dish washing machine for large catering establishments. 2 REFERENCES 2.1 The Indian Standards listed necessary adjuncts to this standard:

with sink, made of stainless steel sheet. The sink shall have a drain connection at the bottom. It shall have round corners. The finished thickness shall be less than 1.25 mm at any point. Washing zone tanks are made of stainless steel sheet with inclined or conical bottom. The finished thickness of tanks at any point shall be not less than 1.25 mm. There shall not be any sharp corners. The joints shall be fusion welded, ground and buffed smooth. 5.2 Unloading Zone Top table shall be made of stainless steel sheet. The finished thickness shall be not less than 1.25 mm at any point. 5.2.1 A steam generator of 18 kW electric load with accessories, such as, safety valve, pressure gauge, pressure switch, gauge glass, inlet and outlet. valves and solenoid valve shall be provided underneath the unloading zone. The steam generator shall satisfy the requirements of boilers in accordance with IS 3829 ( Part 2 ) : 1978. The safety valve shall be adjusted at 1.7 kgf/cm2 and hydraulic test shall be performed at 3 kgf/cm".

3.2 The dish washer shall be designed to operate to direct steam from a central source or by means of electric immersion heaters for heating the water tank below the washing zone. A separate built-in steam generator ( boiler ) shall be provided in the sterilizing zone for electrically operated dish washing machine for spraying steam for sterilizing and drying. 3.3 The dish washing machine shall be capable of washing all types of crockery, cutlery, plates, cups, tumblers, etc, and shall be capable of hygienically cleaning any type of special dishes.

IS 13850 : 1993 5.2.2 Both loading have a raised border 5.3 Tanks The tanks shall be made of galvanized mild steel conforming to IS 226 : 1975 or stainless steel conforming to designation 04 C, 18Ni 10 of IS 6911 : 1972. Tanks shall be fusion welded and the corners shall be rounded. The minimum thickness of zinc coating shall be 8 microns. 5.4 Ratchet Mechanism shall be driven by a motor and The machine gear box. A three phase induction motor of 0.37 kW, 50 Hz and 1 440 rpm conforming to IS 325 : 1978 is recommended with a reduction ratio of 60 : 1. 5.4.1 The speed of ratchet mechanism shall be 210 cm/min or as agreed upon by the manufacturer and purchaser. 5.5 Sprays Powerful sprays shall be provided both from top and bottom to cover the en&ire washing zone. The sprays shall impinge on each and every part of the load. 5.5.1 Only sprays from top shall be provided in the sterilizing area for rinsing and sterilizing the load before it is pushed out of the dish washer by the ratchet mechanism. 5.6 Pomp Each tank shall be pump of sufficient connection to the be directly coupled provided with centrifugal capacity with allied piping sprays. Pumps shall either or monoblock type. and unloading zones shall to avoid spillage of water. the tank. For direct steam heating, be provided to heat the water. 6.2 Thermostat The thermostatic device shall cut off the supply at the set point and restart the supply as soon as the temperature of water in the tank drops below 5�C of the set point. 7 CONTROL PANEL coils shall

The Standard Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
